title: Use this to reach out to recruiters ⬆️
description:
Hi [RECRUITER FIRST NAME],

I’m reaching out to express interest in the [INSERT ROLE] recently posted at [COMPANY NAME]. I applied to the role today and would love to express interest in setting up an introductory call. Please let me know if you are the correct person to contact, or if you can direct me to the appropriate party.. Either way, I believe I’d be a good fit for the role based on my [X] years of experience in [RELEVANT INDUSTRY] and [1-2 RELEVANT SKILLS].

Looking forward to hearing from you!

[NAME]
